next_step.title: Carry out the leftover title decisions nightly
next_step.text: Decisions on titles that have left MAP are saved from their row; the next step runs the script that carries them out every night, then adds Rename and Combine to the leftover row, then the reviewed re-point of exhibits by MAP exhibit id and local title.

changes.text: A title that has left MAP can now be kept, moved or removed from its own row on the Exhibits List, with its CPL type shown and a guard on graded and certification based exhibits (PR 3466). A removed title is left out of the dashboard; nothing is deleted. 446 titles are in this group.

The exhibit count in the Commons Curation ETA now includes the titles MAP carries with no entry yet, taking the larger of the two readings, never their sum (PR 3378). Remaining exhibit work falls: 3,618 on October 27, 3,030 on November 15.

The Commons Curation ETA, drafted for the top of CPL Commons, dates a reference only when its remaining work falls. It is live (PR 3375), and it shows the exhibit count does not fall yet: the list of titles grows by each day's new stamps, so the next step measures remaining titles from the ones MAP carries.
A title cleared in another browser tab or session now reopens its card without a reload, and the two dry-run files the Related panel reads are published, so its folds work on the deployed site.
